03

Channels

0 loaded

Create, edit, and remove memory channels. Changes stay in the image until you write them to the radio.

CSV includes every editable channel option. Import merges by channel number; Replace all also clears occupied slots missing from the file after confirmation. Older channel JSON exports can still be opened.

Edit channel

Changing RX updates TX for simplex or a recognized repeater output. Select + or − when needed; enter TX yourself for a custom split or leave it blank for receive-only.

04

Radio settings

0 loaded

Inspect and edit documented radio, Bluetooth, GNSS, and APRS options from the full backup. Open a group to see its controls. Unknown values remain unchanged unless you select a new value.

Read from the radio or open a backup to inspect its settings.

Fixed GNSS coordinates, stored DTMF codes, FM broadcast presets, and undocumented firmware bytes remain in the backup and are not edited here. Changing APRS beacon or relay options can cause transmissions; review those values before writing.

05

Write changes

No changes

Only changed 32-byte blocks are sent. Before each write, the app checks that the radio still matches the original image, then reads the block back.
